label: Plan standard: a plan ranks one outcome over another by meeting its requirements
definition: planStandard P desc k x y: the description of outcome x meets every requirement of plan k (Meets P k (desc x)) and the description of y does not.
note: Stipulative bridge from the Plan vocabulary of the practical-specification premise (DEF a84afabf) to outcome orderings, so that a source's favouring can be tested for dependence on a plan's standard. It reads only the plan's Requirement field. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
